units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 38:1">Ex. R. s. 38</cite> <he>באתה הה׳</he> the promise came true.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:13">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>גדולה ה׳ וכ׳</he> the divine promise (of reward) to women is greater &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:4">Ib. V, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 38b">Sot. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>ואם הַבְטָחָתוֹ וכ׳</he> but if he is confident that &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76:1">Gen. R. s. 76</cite> <he>אין ה׳ לצדיקים וכ׳</he> the rigtheous do not rely on the divine promise in this world (they are afraid, lest their sin may have caused its withdrawal, v.

<cite ref="Berakhot 4b:14">Ber. 4ᵇ</cite>). Mekh. Yithro s. 2 <he>אנשי אמת אלו בעלי ה׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="A00094"><he>אַבְטָחָה</he></cite>) ‘men of truth’ (<cite ref="Exodus 18:21">Ex. XVIII, 21</cite>) that means men having faith in God; a. e.—Pl. <he>הַבְטָחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19:4">Ex. R. s. 19</cite> <he>הרי כל ה׳ וכ׳</he> are these all the promises held out to the proselyte &c.?; a. fr.
